replay.en: Replayed after the close, as of 9:20 AM: the live routine was blocked by the account's weekly usage limit. The number is mechanical (SOXX pre-market at 9:20 + the statistical model) because post-open data had already been seen.
replay.zh: 收盘后按上午 9:20 的条件补做：当天的自动预测因账户每周用量上限没有运行。由于已经看到开盘后的数据，预测值改用机械规则（9:20 的 SOXX 盘前涨跌 + 统计模型），不含主观判断。

summary.zh: SOXX 盘前涨 1.3%，英伟达、美光、应用材料、科磊等主要成分股普遍上涨，周五小幅反弹后继续修复。统计模型预计开盘后再小涨约 0.1%，合计预测上涨 1.4%。本周有美联储议息和大型科技股财报，波动可能加大。
summary.en: SOXX is up 1.3% pre-market with broad gains across the big members (Nvidia, Micron, Applied Materials, KLA), extending Friday's small bounce. The statistical model adds about 0.1% after the open, for a call of +1.4%. A Fed decision and big-tech earnings this week could add volatility.

factors.zh: 9:20 时 SOXX 盘前涨 1.30%，SMH 涨 1.06%
成分股普遍上涨：美光 +1.9%、科磊 +1.8%、应用材料 +1.7%、阿斯麦 +1.3%、英伟达 +1.0%
factors.en: Broad gains: Micron +1.9%, KLA +1.8%, Applied Materials +1.7%, ASML +1.3%, Nvidia +1.0%

factors.zh: SOX 的 RSI 仅 15，较 20 日均线低 11%，严重超卖
factors.en: SOX deeply oversold: RSI 15, 11% below its 20-day average

factors.zh: 纳指 ETF（QQQ）盘前仅涨 0.45%，Meta 跌 1.9%，AI 融资担忧仍在
factors.en: QQQ only +0.45% pre-market, Meta −1.9%; AI financing worries linger

factors.zh: 本周周三美联储议息，微软、谷歌、亚马逊、Meta 及 SK 海力士、三星发布财报
factors.en: Fed decision Wednesday; Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, SK Hynix and Samsung report this week

risk.zh: 盘前涨幅在开盘后被获利了结，或财报周前资金观望导致回落
risk.en: Pre-market gains get sold at the open, or money waits on the sidelines ahead of earnings week

views.en: Chip stocks shrugged off Friday's scary morning, but history suggests the shakeout isn't over yet.
views.zh: 芯片股挺过了周五早盘的惊吓，但历史经验显示这轮洗盘可能还没结束。

views.en: Markets are on edge before memory makers report; investor caution is described as higher than at almost any time since ChatGPT launched.
views.zh: 存储芯片厂商发布财报前市场紧张，投资者的谨慎程度被形容为 ChatGPT 问世以来几乎最高。

views.en: US futures edge higher before the open as oil eases and Nvidia and other chip stocks rebound, though AI financing concerns still weigh on parts of tech.
views.zh: 开盘前美股期货小涨，油价回落，英伟达等芯片股反弹，但 AI 融资担忧仍压制部分科技股。

views.en: Futures rise as the AI sector heads into a critical week of big-tech earnings and a Fed decision.
views.zh: 期货上涨，AI 板块迎来大型科技股财报和美联储议息的关键一周。
